title: Treatise on the Pinning Shot
summary: Teaches a Senior to pin cloth, hands and feet to wood or ground with qi-driven arrows.

title: Handbook of the Rolling Volley
summary: Shows how a Senior keeps a continuous stream of arrows aimed at one zone with paced qi.

title: Arrow-Breaker's Primer
summary: Teaches a Warrior to send qi-driven arrows through leather and light plate by choice of head and angle.

title: Canon of Mounted Shooting
summary: Sets out the grips, draws and releases an archer uses from a moving mount, with qi to steady each shot.

title: The Long Range Reader
summary: Teaches a Warrior to read distance, light and air at a great span and to loose with qi behind the shaft.

title: Treatise on High-Ground Shooting
summary: Covers shots from ridges, roofs and trees, and how a Senior keeps footing and a clear line down.

title: Handbook of Snare and Net Arrows
summary: Shows a Warrior how to loose cord, net and weighted arrows to hold, trip or tangle a foe.

title: Heavy Bow Primer
summary: Brings a Warrior to draw a heavy-limbed bow and shoot hard flat arrows with the full back and leg.

title: Primer of the Bowman's Guard
summary: Teaches a Senior to guard with the bow itself when a foe closes and a shot is no longer possible.

title: Treatise on Arrow Weather
summary: Teaches a Warrior how rain, fog, dusk and heat change an arrow's flight and how to shoot through them.
